notes: All roles (witness author, both target admins, both negatives, support channel and workspace) already exist verbatim in the base seed; no seed_edits are required. It resolves to exactly the two workspace admins (U03ROBERT23, U07MORGANFREE) of T01WORKSPACE, the workspace owning #core-infra; U_LUKAS and U_OLENA are excluded because their user_teams.role is 'member', not 'admin'. O2's selector targets the existing anchor workspace (teams row for T01WORKSPACE) where the new private 'incident-retro' channel is to be created via conversations.create, since the channel itself does not pre-exist in the seed (it is the state-changing outcome of the task) and thus cannot be the resolved referent prior to task execution. The actor (U01AGENBOT9) is already a member of #core-infra, enabling conversations.history discovery of the diagnostic message and author; workspace admin status is read via users.list/users.info against user_teams.role, and admins need not themselves be members of #core-infra.
